route_identifiability.interpretation: Entropy or subtype confidence does not identify when the hierarchical candidate correction will improve segmentation, so confidence-threshold routing is not supported.

optimization_tradeoff.interpretation: The hierarchy fits the auxiliary labels but pays a large binary, consistency, and drift cost; auxiliary classification improvement is not aligned with candidate extent quality.

ranking_effect.interpretation: The small average rank-quality gain is real but too weak and badly distributed: large benefits while small loses overlap support.

causal_failure_conclusion: The entropy route is not an observable reliability gate for localization quality.
The candidate bag cannot jointly learn subtype recognition and extent-sensitive localization reliably from the same lazy bag objective.
Subtype correctness is a conditional moderator, but using validation correctness or tuning a confidence threshold would be post-hoc leakage and is forbidden.

The next hypothesis must add reliable instance-level identity supervision from image labels or a separately frozen global context; it must not rerun hierarchy weights, entropy thresholds, epochs, fusion, or subgroup routing.

literature_assessment.method: INS instance-level weakly supervised contrastive and prototype learning
literature_assessment.transferable_point: Directly train an instance classifier using true negatives from negative bags and prototype-refined pseudo labels, instead of assuming bag attention is an accurate localization score.
literature_assessment.boundary: T1 already rejected cross-fitted self-paced contrastive residuals, so any successor must be explicitly prototype-driven and decouple instance ranking from the bag-probability residual rather than relabel T1.

literature_assessment.transferable_point: Cross-view prototype consistency and class compactness can narrow the image-to-instance supervision gap.
literature_assessment.boundary: The paper also reports degeneration from inaccurate weak pseudo labels; semi-hard filtering and exact view consistency are mandatory if transferred.

literature_assessment.transferable_point: Pseudo-bags address few bags with extremely many instances.
literature_assessment.boundary: BTXRD already has 2,981 train bags and modest candidate bags; repartitioning candidates does not add tumor identity and is not the next priority.

literature_assessment.transferable_point: Masking high-attention instances can expose hard evidence under bag supervision.
literature_assessment.boundary: BTXRD small lesions may have a single useful proposal, so masking the strongest proposal can destroy the only positive instance; this is deferred without proven redundancy.

forbidden_posthoc_actions: No hierarchy loss-weight or epoch sweep
No use of validation subtype correctness to modify frozen predictions
